children.text: Greeting
children.cn: 书信开头与问候

children.text: Dear Mike,
children.cn: 亲爱的迈克：
children.notes: 信件开头称谓，Dear后面跟收信人的名字，末尾用逗号。
children.statement: “Dear Mike,” 是英文书信正文前常用的称呼语。
children.explanation: 题干中已给出称呼，按中考写作规则不计入正文总词数。

children.text: Personal Info & Family
children.cn: 个人信息与家庭情况

children.text: I am Li Hua, a thirteen-year-old student from China.
children.cn: 我是李华，一名来自中国的十三岁学生。
children.notes: thirteen-year-old 作定语修饰 student，复合形容词中单位名词用单数。
children.statement: “thirteen-year-old” 是复合形容词，中间的“year”必须用单数形式。
children.explanation: 数词-名词-形容词构成复合定语时，名词用单数。

children.text: I am short and a little quiet, but I am very friendly.
children.cn: 我个子不高，有点安静，但我很友善。
children.notes: a little 修饰形容词 quiet；but 连接转折分句。
children.statement: 句中“but”表示前后分句之间的转折关系。
children.explanation: but为并列连词，用于转折对比性格与外貌特征。

children.text: There are four people in my family: my parents, my elder sister and me.
children.cn: 我家有四口人：我的父母、我的姐姐和我。
children.notes: There be 句型表示“有”；elder sister 表示姐姐。
children.statement: 句中“There are”根据其后的复数主语“four people”确定be动词形式。
children.explanation: There be 句型遵循就近原则和主谓一致原则，four people为复数，用are。

children.text: My father is a doctor and my mother is an English teacher.
children.cn: 我父亲是一名医生，我母亲是一名英语教师。
children.notes: doctor 前用冠词 a；English teacher 前元音音素开头用冠词 an。
children.statement: 因为“English”以元音音素开头，其前的不定冠词必须使用“an”。
children.explanation: 元音音素开头的单数可数名词前用an修饰。

children.text: Hobbies & Sign-off
children.cn: 兴趣爱好与书信结尾

children.text: In my free time, I like sports and I often play basketball.
children.cn: 在空闲时间，我喜欢运动，并且经常打篮球。
children.notes: in one's free time: 在某人的空闲时间；play basketball: 打篮球（球类名词前不加冠词）。
children.statement: 在表达“打篮球”时，球类名称“basketball”前不加任何定冠词。
children.explanation: 球类运动前直接接动词play，零冠词。

children.text: I can also draw nice pictures of animals.
children.cn: 我还会画漂亮的动物图画。
children.notes: draw pictures of...: 画……的图画；情态动词 can 后面接动词原形。
children.statement: 情态动词“can”后面必须跟动词原形“draw”。
children.explanation: 情态动词can表示能力，后接实义动词原形。

children.text: What about you? Can you tell me about yourself?
children.cn: 你呢？你能给我讲讲你自己的情况吗？
children.notes: What about you?: 你呢？；tell sb. about sth.: 告诉某人关于……；yourself: 你自己（反身代词）。
children.statement: “yourself”是反身代词，意为“你自己”。
children.explanation: 此处用反身代词yourself指代对方自己，作为承上启下的过渡互动句。
children.keywords: What about you, tell me, yourself

children.text: I am looking forward to your early reply.
children.cn: 我期待着你的早日回复。
children.notes: look forward to doing/sth.: 期待……，其中 to 为介词。
children.statement: 本句为题干已给出的书信结尾句，不计入总词数。
children.explanation: 题目已给出预设结语句，按规则 word_count 为 0。

children.text:
Yours,
Li Hua
children.cn:
你的，
李华
children.notes: Yours,: 书信尾部敬辞署名。
children.statement: “Yours, Li Hua”为信末署名，已给出且不计入正文总词数。
children.explanation: 预设署名不计入学生正文字数。

children.text: Greeting
children.cn: 书信开头与问候

children.text: Dear Mike,
children.cn: 亲爱的迈克：
children.notes: 信件开头称谓，与基础范文保持完全一致。
children.statement: 预设信件开头称呼在基础范文与高级范文中完全一致。
children.explanation: 规则要求预设句在两篇范文中必须100%保持一致，词数为0。

children.text: Personal Info & Family Details
children.cn: 个人详情与家庭风貌

children.text: Through the Chinese Bridge activity, I am very glad to tell you something about myself.
children.cn: 通过汉语桥活动，我很高兴向你介绍一下我自己。
children.notes: through 介词表“通过”；be glad to do sth. 乐于做某事。
children.statement: 短语“be glad to do sth.”在此处表示做某事感到高兴。
children.explanation: glad后接动词不定式to tell作原因状语。

children.text: Although I am a little short and quiet, I am always full of energy and helpful to others.
children.cn: 虽然我个子有点矮且文静，但我总是精力充沛并且乐于助人。
children.notes: Although 引导让步状语从句；be full of 充满；be helpful to 对……有帮助。
children.statement: “Although”引导让步状语从句，主句中不能再用“but”。
children.explanation: 英语语法中although与but不能同时出现在同一并列句中。

children.text: There are four warm-hearted members in my family, including my hard-working parents, my lovely sister and me.
children.cn: 我家里有四位热心的成员，包括辛勤工作的父母、可爱的姐姐和我。
children.notes: including 是介词，用来举例说明包含的对象；hard-working 为复合形容词。
children.statement: 句中“including”作为介词使用，意为“包括……在内”。
children.explanation: including常带出宾语说明总数中的具体成分。

children.text: My father works as a doctor in a hospital, while my mother is an experienced English teacher.
children.cn: 我父亲在一家医院当医生，而我母亲是一位经验丰富的英语老师。
children.notes: work as: 从事……工作；while 表对比转折，意为“而，然而”。
children.statement: 从属连词“while”在句中表示两种情况的对比转折。
children.explanation: while在此处用于对比父母不同的职业分工。

children.text: Passions & Sign-off
children.cn: 兴趣特长与书信结尾

children.text: As for my hobbies, I am really crazy about ball games, especially playing basketball with my classmates.
children.cn: 至于我的爱好，我非常痴迷于球类运动，尤其是和同班同学打篮球。
children.notes: as for: 至于；be crazy about: 热衷于，着迷于；especially: 尤其。
children.statement: 短语“be crazy about”表达强烈的喜爱与狂热爱好。
children.explanation: be crazy about 比 simple like 表达更高级丰富的情感色彩。

children.text: In addition, drawing is another great passion of mine because it helps me record the beauty of life.
children.cn: 此外，画画是我的另一大爱好，因为它能帮助我记录生活中的美好。
children.notes: In addition: 此外；passion: 热情/爱好；because 引导原因状语从句。
children.statement: 连接副词“In addition”在句首起补充递进的作用。
children.explanation: In addition使得上下文论述更加丰富连贯。
children.keywords: In addition, drawing, passion, record, beauty

children.text: How about you? I would love to know more about you.
children.cn: 你呢？我很想了解更多关于你的事情。
children.notes: How about you?: 你呢？；would love to do sth.: 很想做某事；know more about: 了解更多关于……。
children.statement: 短语“would love to do sth.”在此处表示委婉、热切的意愿。
children.explanation: would love to do 比 want to do 更加礼貌亲切，适合书信交流与过渡。
children.keywords: How about you, love to know, more about you

children.text: I am looking forward to your early reply.
children.cn: 我期待着你的早日回复。
children.notes: 题干给出的书信结尾，与基础范文一致，不计入总词数。
children.statement: 预设结尾句在高级范文中与基础范文保持一字不差。
children.explanation: 预设结尾严格保持一致，word_count 记为 0。

children.text:
Yours,
Li Hua
children.cn:
你的，
李华
children.notes: 信末署名，与基础范文保持一致，不计入总词数。
children.statement: 预设署名在高级范文中与基础范文保持一致，不计入总词数。
children.explanation: 预设署名 word_count 为 0。
